newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Cascade Comm dives.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Cascade Comm dives.

text.p: Shares of Cascade Communications Corp plummeted about 19 points in U.S pre-opening trade Friday morning on concerns among traders over margins and growth.

Shares were trading as low as 45-1/2 per share, off from the Thursday close of 64-1/8. Cascade reported sharply higher fourth quarter earnings after the market closed on Thursday, but traders said there were concerns about margins and growth in Cascade's main business.
Cascade posted earnings of $0.24 per share versus $0.10 a year ago.
Cascade provides wide area networking products for enterprise and public carrier network markets.
PepsiCo traded as high as 35-1/4, up one from the Thursday close of 34-1/4.

Pepsi said earlier Friday that it expects to spin off its restaurant businesses by the end of this year, and also said it expected repurchases of its shares to continue, and perhaps accelerate after the spinoff. Shares gained 3-1/2 on Thursday on news reports of the planned spinoff.
International Business Machines Corp traded off to 151-3/8, off from the Thursday close of 151-3/4.
